summary.en: Sonoko take Ran and Conan to the "Candy House" in the Ecriture. In there, Conan meets a group of three masters who make pastries and puddings: Tsuyoshi Maeda the "Iron Pastry" Chief, Yasuo Fujino the "Prince of Pastries", and Yumi Morimoto the "Candy Magician". They taste the sweets that the three chefs made, which are very delicious. Later, they suddenly hear a scream. Location: Candy House Victim: Sachiko Hashigaki Cause of death: Heavy blow to head Suspects: Tsuyoshi Maeda, Yasuo Fujino, and Yumi Morimoto Sachiko is discovered lying dead on the floor of the Candy House. The suspects all have motives for murdering Hashigaki, but Morimoto becomes the prime suspect as she is the only one who stayed inside the Ecriture.
